title: Restore glass Agent Orb and stabilize startup and tab rendering
goal: Restore the approved animated glass orb, stop non-critical startup discovery failures from appearing as chat request errors, and isolate stream-driven rendering to the chat message list.
context: Issue #429 consolidates the startup Attention Agent error, orb visual regression, and lag from broad tab rendering. Chat send-arrow sizing is tracked separately in PR #430.
forbidden_changes: Do not modify PersonalAgent.xcodeproj or unrelated application files.
Do not suppress genuine model-loading or request-execution failures.
Do not introduce orbit rings, particles, avatar artwork, global timers, or a UI architecture rewrite.
Do not claim performance gains without profiling or reproducible evidence.
acceptance_criteria: AgentOrb uses a glass-sphere treatment with a small state-driven pulse and no rotating rings or particles.
Non-critical skill, agent-profile, and model-inventory discovery failures do not populate the chat request error banner during startup.
Genuine active-model engine and request execution errors remain visible.
Orb animation stops when its view disappears and only pulses while thinking.
Chat stream updates are isolated in a dedicated message-list subview.
Changes stay within one logical commit and the PR diff is reviewed.
verification: Run python3 Scripts/agent_task_guard.py check-diff Tasks/active/PAUI-28.json --base origin/main.
Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI gates.
Profile affected tabs on an iPhone before claiming measured performance improvement.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the orb fails to render, startup errors are incorrectly suppressed, or chat streaming regresses.
